title: Waste management plan for five or more grouped dwellings (Note)
text: Note: Where five or more grouped dwellings are proposed, a waste management plan to the satisfaction of the decision-maker, is to be provided.

replaces.note: waste management plan DTC for 5+ grouped dwellings reduced to a Note (register ch3-033)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New in Chapter 3. Printed as a Note in the deemed exempt column after C2.4.3, not a numbered clause; 'to the satisfaction of the decision-maker' needs a planner, so judgment. verify: whether a Note binds as a deemed exempt provision.

verified.note: Wording and the five-dwelling trigger match p21. Ambiguous on the page: printed as an unnumbered italic Note in the deemed exempt column below C2.4.3, so whether it binds as a deemed exempt provision is not stated.
